card.title: Xbox Elite Controller Series 2 RB or LB is sometimes registering clicks fine, sometimes is held down or sometimes does not register clicks at all

source.title: Xbox Elite Controller Series 2 RB or LB is sometimes registering clicks fine, sometimes is held down or sometimes does not register clicks at all

symptoms: RB/LB intermittent, stuck held or dead

claims.statement: Erratic RB/LB on Elite Series 2 (sometimes fine, sometimes stuck or dead) is usually the IO expander marked 'NXP L16A' (PCAL6416AHF) on the blue board, not the switches.

procedure: Replace PCAL6416AHF on the blue board.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
